subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — hybrid on-prem + edge sites
messages:
From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@opslyft.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Wallace <ethan.wallace@opslyft.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment pricing — hybrid on-prem + edge sites

Hi Diego,

Hope you’re well — we’re evaluating Redwood for a private deployment (VPC) that covers two distinct footprints:

- Core: 12 x A100-equivalent GPUs spread across 3 DCs (primary inference capacity)
- Edge: ~10 remote sites running single-GPU edge appliances for low-latency local inference and sparse KV cache syncs

Key asks from procurement/CPO: a clear breakdown of (1) licensing model (per-GPU vs per-site/operator), (2) annual platform fee scope, and (3) support tiers + response SLAs. We’re also interested in any migration/onboarding credits for a multi-year commit and whether you can offer a blended commercial for pilot -> full rollout.

Target timeline: pilot in Dec, production by Mar. Please include: sample SOW line items (migration, runbook, handover), a ballpark for three-year vs one-year commitments, and typical payment terms.

I’ve attached a very high-level architecture diagram.

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Simmons
CPO, OpsLyft
laura.simmons@opslyft.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Cc: Ethan Wallace <ethan.wallace@opslyft.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — hybrid on-prem + edge sites

Laura — thanks for the clear brief and the diagram. High-level commercial for planning (ballpark, subject to SOW/infra validation):

Option A — Anchored 3-year (best unit economics):
- Core licenses: $16,800 per GPU / year (covers inference runtime + kernel support). For 12 GPUs = $201,600 / year.
- Edge appliance license: $3,200 per edge site / year (single GPU optimized edge runtime). For 10 sites = $32,000 / year.
- Platform fee: $120,000 / year (Console, multi-tenant control plane, analytics, rollout tooling).
- Support: Premium (24x7 on-call, 1-hour P1, 4-hour P2) add-on $65,000 / year.
- One-time migration/onboarding SOW: estimated $55k (data migration + runbook + 2-week SRE onsite/remote).
- 3-year commit: we can offer a migration credit equal to 12% of Year 1 license spend (applied as credit toward SOW or first invoice).

Option B — 12-month pilot (lower commitment):
- Core licenses: $19,800 per GPU / year (premium short-term rate).
- Edge: $3,900 per edge site / year.
- Platform fee: $140,000 / year (pilot includes limited analytics retention).
- Support: Standard 9x5 (business-hours) included; 24x7 available as add-on.
- Minimal onboarding retainer: $25k (reduced, paid upfront).

Trade-offs and notes:
- We price core as per-GPU to align with throughput, and edge per-site to keep low fixed cost for appliances. Operator seats (admin users + SSO) are included in the platform fee; additional SRE retainer hours are metered.
- For the hybrid model we’ll design a KV-sync pattern to minimize egress. Priyom (cc’d) can confirm feasibility for your sync cadence.

I’ll attach a short pricing teaser and draft SOW. If you’re happy, I’ll follow up with a formal quote and a proposed canary rollout plan.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: OpsLyft pricing request — ask: concession guidance

Forwarding OpsLyft thread — procurement is pushing hard on credits and wants a blended price to cover both core and edge. My read: they want ~25-30% off list for a 3-year anchor. My proposed concession package (to present, configurable):

- Commercial: 15% off license list for Years 1–3 (core and edge), 25% off platform fee Year 1 only.
- Credits: migration credit = $50k (applied to SOW or Year 1 invoice); waive onboarding retainer in exchange for 3-year MSA + 12-month prepay.
- Ops: include 1 SRE-week (40 hours) at no charge during cutover; additional SRE weeks billed at standard T&M.

Questions:
- Marissa: OK to present 15% license discount + $50k credit as negotiable concession?
- Priyom: can we commit to the free SRE-week and the KV-sync work in the proposed Jan-Mar rollout? Any hidden infra costs we should flag?
- Irene: if we go this route, legal will want MSA with termination clauses — flag any deal-breakers.

Pls reply with quick yes/no and any edits — need to send customer a revised summary by EOD Wed.

Thanks,
Diego
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: OpsLyft pricing request — ask: concession guidance

Diego — quick thoughts, approved with guardrails:

- Commercial: authorize 15% off licensing (Years 1–3) and 25% off platform fee for Year 1 only.
- Credits/Onboarding: cap migration credit at $60k (not to exceed 30% of Year 1 license spend) and waive the $25k onboarding retainer if OpsLyft signs an 18-month minimum commitment with a 45-day payment term.
- Ops commitment: approve 1 complimentary SRE-week during cutover; any additional SRE beyond the week is billable at the standard rate. Priyom to confirm schedule.
- Contract/legal: Irene — please prepare a short term-sheet (no indemnity expansion) and flag any unusual termination or escrow asks; route to Legal for a fast-track redline.

I’m attaching a very short draft term sheet to use as the first offer. I don’t want to give more than the $60k credit without Rev approval.

Marissa
VP, Commercial — Redwood Inference

Laura — thanks again for the quick turn. Below is a concise commercial summary and next steps; attached are the formal quote and SOW for review.

Commercial summary (offer):
- Term: 3-year commitment (preferred) with annual invoices; 18-month minimum required to unlock onboarding waiver.
- Licensing (after 15% concession): Core: $14,280 per GPU / year -> $171,360 / year for 12 GPUs. Edge: $2,720 per site / year -> $27,200 / year for 10 sites.
- Platform fee (Year 1): $90,000 (25% off list for Year 1). Years 2–3 at list unless otherwise agreed.
- Support: Premium 24x7 add-on $65,000 / year (optional). Standard 9x5 included.
- Migration credits: $50,000 credit (applied to migration SOW or Year 1 invoices). Cap authorized by Rev: $60k; we’ve offered $50k to stay conservative.
- One complimentary SRE-week (40 hours) during migration window; additional SRE billed per SOW T&M.
- Payment terms: Net 45; invoice schedule: Yearly in advance or Year 1 prepaid to release migration credits (negotiable).

Attachments: OpsLyft_PrivDeploy_Quote_20261104.pdf, SOW_opslyft_migration_20261104.pdf (includes milestone schedule: pilot -> canary -> prod, runbook, acceptance tests). DocuSign links included in the quote for quick signature.

Next steps:
1) Review quote + SOW and annotate redlines in DocuSign by EOD Fri.
2) If acceptable, sign MSA + initial invoice to start provisioning (we’ll schedule kickoff and a 2-week pre-cutover readiness check).
3) Priyom — can we pencil Jan 10–24 for migration and KV-sync testing if OpsLyft signs this week?

I’m happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk the team through the SOW.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
